input.final_summary: Locked four section layouts: Audience Fit Matrix (ruled 2×2, no boxes), Process Spine (vertical timeline with lime index), Deliverables Spec Sheet (single chrome panel, two-column rows), Differ Contrast Board (ink stage with lime lead cell). Renderer-only; JSON fields unchanged.

content.text:
**Locked layouts** (renderer-only; `title` + `description` fields unchanged). Kill per-item `hardPanel` / `hardPanelMuted` / `hardPanelLime` on these four sections.

---

### Audience → **Fit Matrix**
One chrome shell; cells divided by hairlines. No nested cards.

| Viewport | Structure |
|---|---|
| Desktop | Outer `border-2 border-primary` + hard shadow. Inner CSS grid `2×2`. Dividers via `border-r` / `border-b` on cells (ink `#131311`), not gaps. Cell pad `1.5–2rem`. |
| Mobile | Same shell. `1` col; cells stack with `border-b` only (last cell none). |

**CSS rules:** no per-cell radius/shadow/bg; title `text-h4` ink; body secondary; optional `01–04` as plain typography (not lime badge tiles); section stays muted tone.

---

### Process (`solution.steps`) → **Process Spine**
Open vertical timeline. No step cards.

| Viewport | Structure |
|---|---|
| Desktop | `ol` with left rail `~3.5rem`. Continuous ink spine (`w-px` absolute). Lime index discs (`h-9 w-9`, `bg-accent`, `border-2 border-primary`) on the spine. Copy open to the right (`pl` into content). Step gap `2–2.5rem`. |
| Mobile | Same spine; content full remaining width; slightly tighter pad. |

**CSS rules:** zero step borders/shadows/fills; number is the only chrome; last step has no trailing spine below marker; keep semantic `<ol>`.

---

### Deliverables → **Spec Sheet**
One chrome shell; ledger rows. No card grid.

| Viewport | Structure |
|---|---|
| Desktop | Outer panel + hard shadow. Inside: `grid-cols-2`, row gaps = hairlines only (`divide-y` + vertical mid rule). Each cell: title semibold + description `text-small` secondary. Zebra: odd rows `bg-surface-muted`, even transparent. |
| Mobile | Same shell; `1` col; every item a full-width row with bottom hairline. |

**CSS rules:** lime used once as a `4px` top edge on the shell (or a short ink label “Includes”); drop per-item dots; density from type + rules, not boxes.

---

### Differ → **Contrast Board**
Ink stage + one lime lead; three open companions. Ends equal lime tiles.

| Viewport | Structure |
|---|---|
| Desktop | Section (or full-width board) `bg-primary` ink. Inner `2×2` with lime hairline dividers (`border-accent/40` or solid lime at `1px`). Cell `0`: `bg-accent`, ink type. Cells `1–3`: transparent ink stage, titles `text-text-on-dark`, body `on-dark/80`. |
| Mobile | Stack in same ink board; lime hairlines between; cell `0` still lime band on top. |

**CSS rules:** no white cards, no equal lime fills, no icons; only index `0` gets lime fill; outer board may keep hard chrome edge if needed for PO consistency.

---

### Rhythm lock (so the page does not re-monotonize)
`Fit Matrix` (ruled white) → `Process Spine` (open + lime markers) → `Spec Sheet` (dense ledger) → `Contrast Board` (ink/lime stage). Four different information grammars; PO preserved; no purple, emoji, or dashboard chrome.
